narration.text: A technician's year of airline credits becomes refunds: flights moved nearly four and six and a half hours, a new arrival airport, an added stop, a lower fare class and a seat fee, while a change she made, a credit she chose, her own cancellation, a short delay, a spent credit and an uncovered flight are left alone, across five portals. This is a chore for a veterinary technician in Boston who holds travel credits from two airlines and a travel agency, most of them issued without her asking. On the bench, she found 6 of 6 eligible items, worth 832 dollars of the 832 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 9 traps, and she walked past 9. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes about 2 hours, so she was about 94 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
